name: Podcast Episode Planning
description: Creative production template for planning podcast episodes, guest angles, story beats, and publishing tasks.

sections.title: Episode Concept
sections.instruction: Capture episode title or working title, core premise, audience, guest, and desired listener takeaway

sections.title: Story Arc
sections.instruction: Summarize the planned narrative flow, main beats, tension, reveal, or progression

sections.title: Questions & Prompts
sections.instruction: List host questions, follow-up prompts, and sensitive or must-ask topics

sections.title: Guest Notes
sections.instruction: Summarize guest background, expertise, boundaries, anecdotes, and pre-interview signals

sections.title: Production Requirements
sections.instruction: List recording setup, assets, clips, music, ads, legal releases, and technical needs

sections.title: Title, Hook & Promotion Ideas
sections.instruction: Capture possible episode titles, opening hooks, social clips, newsletter angles, or pull quotes

sections.title: Publishing Checklist
sections.instruction: List post-production, review, publishing, and distribution tasks with owners
